4export default function JournalForm() {
5  const [title, setTitle] = useState('')
6  const [content, setContent] = useState('')
7  const addEntry = useJournalStore((state) => state.addEntry)
8 
9  function handleSubmit(e) {
10    e.preventDefault()
11    if (!title.trim() || !content.trim()) return
12    addEntry(title, content)
13    setTitle('')
14    setContent('')
15  }
16 
17  return (
18    <form className="journal-form" onSubmit={handleSubmit}>

20        className="input-field"
21        type="text"
22        placeholder="Entry title"
23        value={title}
24        onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)}
25      />

27        className="textarea-field"

Here is what is happening. Every time theme or searchQuery changes Zustand saves them to localStorage. When the page reloads it reads them back before the app renders. So dark mode stays dark. The search stays set. And the entries are fetched fresh from the API just like always.
